labs.title: Trace a Stale Price Through Storefront Boundaries
labs.simulationLabel: Synthetic evidence; not executed against Composable Storefront or SAP Commerce Cloud
labs.initialSituation: Backoffice shows a changed price while one product page still renders the previous value.
constraints: no production code change during diagnosis
safeActions: verify SSR and client navigation separately
labs.rootCause: An obsolete SSR cache entry survived the pricing update; client state hydrated from that entry.

labs.title: Synchronization Completes but Storefront Data Is Stale
labs.simulationLabel: Synthetic Backoffice/search/OCC evidence; no live administration operation
labs.initialSituation: Catalog synchronization reports success but a product is absent from storefront search.

available: Solr update job missing item count

constraints: do not rerun full synchronization blindly
safeActions: run bounded index update in approved environment
labs.rootCause: Index update failed after successful catalog synchronization.

labs.title: Investigate and Recover a Failed Cloud Deployment
labs.simulationLabel: Synthetic Cloud Portal/OpenSearch/Dynatrace evidence; no live SAP cloud environment
labs.initialSituation: A migrate-data deployment fails and the previous application build no longer starts cleanly.
constraints: no assumption that old build is schema-compatible
safeActions: evaluate corrected migrate-data redeploy versus restore
escalate managed database recovery when required
labs.rootCause: An incompatible custom schema migration failed after partially changing metadata.
